privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to us. This policy explains how Habiba Store collects, uses, and protects your personal information.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as your name, email address, phone number, shipping address, and payment details when you place an order or create an account.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use your information to process orders, deliver products, communicate with you about your account, and improve our services. We never sell your personal information to third parties.

sections.heading: 3. Data Security
sections.body: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information, including encryption, secure servers, and access controls.

sections.heading: 4. Cookies
sections.body: We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience, remember your preferences, and analyze site traffic. You can disable cookies in your browser settings.

sections.heading: 5. Your Rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information at any time. Contact us at hello@habibastore.com for any privacy-related requests.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using Habiba Store, you agree to the following terms and conditions.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By accessing or using our website and services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and all applicable laws and regulations.

sections.heading: 2. Use of Our Service
sections.body: You agree to use Habiba Store only for lawful purposes and in a way that does not infringe the rights of others or restrict their use and enjoyment of the service.

sections.heading: 3. Products and Pricing
sections.body: All prices are displayed in EGP and are subject to change without notice. We reserve the right to modify or discontinue products at any time.

sections.heading: 4. Orders and Payment
sections.body: When you place an order, you agree to provide accurate and complete information. Payment must be made in full before orders are shipped.

sections.heading: 5. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: Habiba Store shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of our services.

shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.intro: We are committed to delivering your gifts safely and on time.

sections.heading: 1. Processing Time
sections.body: Orders are processed within 1-2 business days. You will receive a confirmation email once your order has been shipped.

sections.heading: 2. Delivery Time
sections.body: Standard delivery within Egypt takes 3-5 business days. International shipping typically takes 7-14 business days depending on destination.

sections.heading: 3. Shipping Costs
sections.body: Shipping fees are calculated at checkout based on your location and order size. Free shipping is available on orders over a certain amount.

sections.heading: 4. Order Tracking
sections.body: Once your order ships, you will receive a tracking number by email. You can also track your order from your account dashboard.

sections.heading: 5. Lost or Damaged Packages
sections.body: If your package is lost or arrives damaged, please contact us immediately at hello@habibastore.com and we will resolve the issue promptly.

returns.title: Returns & Exchanges
returns.intro: We want you to be completely satisfied with your purchase.

sections.heading: 1. Return Window
sections.body: You may return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, provided they are in original condition and packaging.

sections.heading: 2. Non-Returnable Items
sections.body: For hygiene and safety reasons, certain items such as candles that have been lit, personalized gifts, and gift cards cannot be returned.

sections.heading: 3. How to Return
sections.body: To initiate a return, contact us at hello@habibastore.com with your order number. We will provide you with return instructions.

sections.heading: 4. Refunds
sections.body: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive your returned item. The refund will be issued to the original payment method.

sections.heading: 5. Exchanges
sections.body: If you received a defective or incorrect item, we will cover the cost of return shipping and send a replacement right away.

giftCards.title: Gift Cards
giftCards.intro: The perfect gift for any occasion — let them choose exactly what they love.

sections.heading: 1. How It Works
sections.body: Our digital gift cards are delivered instantly by email and can be redeemed on any purchase at Habiba Store.

sections.heading: 2. Available Amounts
sections.body: Gift cards are available in denominations from 100 EGP to 5,000 EGP. Custom amounts can be requested by contacting us.

sections.heading: 3. No Expiration
sections.body: Gift cards never expire and have no hidden fees. The balance can be used across multiple purchases.

sections.heading: 4. How to Redeem
sections.body: At checkout, simply enter your gift card code in the gift card field. The amount will be applied automatically to your order.

sections.heading: 5. Terms
sections.body: Gift cards are non-refundable and cannot be exchanged for cash. They can only be used on habibastore.com.

about.title: Crafting Joy Since Day One
about.subtitle: Habiba Store was born from a simple belief — that a thoughtful gift can turn an ordinary moment into a cherished memory.
about.storyTitle: From a small studio to thousands of homes
about.storyP1: It started with a single candle, hand-poured in a small studio, wrapped with ribbon and sent to a friend. That friend told another. And another. Soon, what began as a personal passion became a mission: to curate gifts that feel personal, meaningful, and truly joyful.
about.storyP2: Today, Habiba Store brings together artisans, small makers, and thoughtful designers from around the world. Every product is handpicked, tested, and chosen for the moment it will create.
about.storyP3: We believe in elegance without excess, warmth without pretension. Whether it's a birthday, a thank-you, or simply 'thinking of you' — we're here to help you say it beautifully.
about.valuesSubtitle: Every decision we make is guided by these simple values.
about.value1Text: Every product is handpicked and tested by our team before it reaches you.
about.value2Text: We partner only with makers who share our obsession with quality.
about.value3Text: Behind every gift is a story, a maker, and a moment worth celebrating.
about.value4Text: Sustainable materials and ethical sourcing guide every choice we make.
about.ctaTitle: Ready to Find the Perfect Gift?
about.ctaText: Explore our collection and discover something truly special.
